reading_note: The teaching describes three enduring foundations of divine truth (rocks) set by the Lord in three discrete degrees of reception. The first is the awakening call of divine truth (the Perfect Man / Ambassador) which becomes the supporting axis from natural to celestial; the second is the new ground of truth-from-good (new land of light) established upon the natural mind dominated by falsity, conquering the root and sting of spiritual death; the third is divine truth in its rescuing form (Jesus the Glorious) summoned forth as the great Thought. The arc moves from the upholding axis, to the conquering ground in ultimates, to the redeeming truth — all three established from the Divine purpose itself, three foundations that secure the whole of regeneration.
